Derived, not a datasheet row: SR latch of two cross-coupled 74LS02 NOR gates (TI SN74LS02). The output that falls does so one tPHL after its input (10/15); the output that rises follows one tPLH later, tPHL + tPLH (10 + 10 / 15 + 15)

Derived, not a datasheet row: /S-/R latch of two cross-coupled 74LS00 NAND gates (TI SN74LS00 SDLS025). The output that rises does so one tPLH after its input (9/15); the output that falls follows one tPHL later, tPLH + tPHL (9 + 10 / 15 + 15)

TI SDLS095A, October 1976, revised March 1988 (SN74LS283), switching characteristics, CL = 15 pF, RL = 2 kOhm, VCC = 5 V, TA = 25 C

TI SDLS123, March 1974, revised March 1988 (SN74LS85), switching characteristics, CL = 15 pF, RL = 2 kOhm, VCC = 5 V, TA = 25 C. Data rows take the slowest published gate level (3 levels to A>B and A<B, 4 to A=B), the only ones with a max column; cascade rows are A<B or A=B to A>B, A=B to A=B, and A>B or A=B to A<B
TI SDLS152, December 1972, revised March 1988 (SN74LS280), switching characteristics, data to even and data to odd, CL = 15 pF, RL = 2 kOhm, inputs not under test at 0 V, VCC = 5 V, TA = 25 C

ON Semi SN74LS47/D rev 6 (Dec 1999) switching characteristics: address input to segment output and RBI input to segment output, both tPLH/tPHL 100 ns. The datasheet publishes a max column only -- no typ figure exists for this part, so `typ` is absent rather than invented
National DM74LS48 TL/F/10172 (Jan 1992) switching characteristics: An to a-g and RBI to a-f, both tPLH/tPHL 100 ns, max column only. Same figures as the '47 and, like it, no published typ

TI SDLS119, December 1983, revised March 1988 (SN74LS74A), switching characteristics, RL = 2 kOhm, CL = 15 pF: one row times CLR, PRE or CLK to Q or /Q, so all three arcs carry it; setup 20 ns for high and low data alike, hold 5 ns
TI SN74LS157 SDLS058 (data/select/strobe rows, direct per-arc)
TI SN74LS153 SDLS055A (data/select/strobe rows, direct per-arc)
TI SN74LS151 SDLS054, December 1972, revised March 1988 (Y and W output rows, direct per-arc; sel_to_y is the 4-level row, sel_to_w the 3-level row)
TI SN74150 SDLS054 (non-LS TTL -- no LS-family 16:1 mux was ever made; owner-approved M6.5 exception, family mismatch with the rest of this DB. Output is the inverted W pin, mapped to our y arc.)

TI SN74LS138 SDLS014 (sel_to_y worst of the 2-level/3-level select rows; en_to_y worst of the 2-level/3-level enable rows -- our decoder is one active-high path per select/enable, not a per-level breakdown)

TI SN74LS148 SDLS053B, October 1976, revised May 2004 (i_to_y worst of in-phase/out-of-phase A0-A2 rows; i_to_valid from the 0-7-to-GS row, GS stands in for our valid output; i_to_eo from the 0-7-to-EO row; EI rows direct)

TI SN54LS139A/SN74LS139A SDLS013A (sel_to_y worst of the 2-level/3-level binary-select rows, mirroring 74LS138's convention; en_to_y from the enable row, 2 levels only -- our demux's data pin maps to this part's active-low enable, which doubles as the data line in demultiplexing mode)

National DM74LS154 TL/F/6394 (May 1989) switching characteristics, RL = 2 kOhm, CL = 15 pF column; the datasheet publishes a max column only, so `typ` is absent (its 23 ns and 19 ns typicals appear only in the features list, not the table). The 'Data to Output' row is this part's 4-line binary-select path, mapped to sel_to_y; 'Strobe to Output' is mapped to en_to_y, which our demux's own data pin `d` also resolves to per codecPathKey, matching 74LS139/74LS138's real strobe-doubles-as-data-input behavior

TI SDLS120, March 1974, revised March 1988 (SN74LS75), switching characteristics, CL = 15 pF, RL = 2 kOhm, 'LS75 column: D to Q, D to /Q, C to Q, C to /Q; C is the latch enable. Setup 20 ns, hold 5 ns

TI SDLS060, October 1976, revised March 1988 (SN74LS161A), switching characteristics, CL = 15 pF, RL = 2 kOhm: clk_to_q is the worst of the LOAD-high and LOAD-low CLK to Q rows (they are equal); CLR to Q is published as tPHL only, measured from the clear input. Setup 20 ns for A-D, ENP or ENT and LOAD; hold 3 ns at any input

TI SDLS060, October 1976, revised March 1988 (SN74LS163A), switching characteristics, CL = 15 pF, RL = 2 kOhm: the 'LS163A clear is synchronous and its CLR to Q tPHL (20/28) is measured from the clock, so clk_to_q tPHL is the worst of that row and the LOAD-high and LOAD-low CLK to Q rows (18/27). Setup 20 ns for A-D, ENP or ENT and LOAD; clear is the worse of CLR (20) and CLR inactive state (25); hold 3 ns at any input
TI SDLS061, March 1974, revised March 1988 (SN74LS164), switching characteristics, RL = 2 kOhm, CL = 15 pF: CLR to Q is published as tPHL only. Data setup 15 ns, data hold 5 ns

TI SDLS062D, October 1976, revised February 2002 (SN74LS165A), switching characteristics, RL = 2 kOhm, CL = 15 pF: LD to any output, CLK to any output, H to QH and H to /QH. The only input sampled at the edge is SER, so setup is the serial input's 20 ns; hold 0 ns at any input

TI SDLS068A, December 1972, revised October 2001 (SN74LS175), switching characteristics, CL = 15 pF, RL = 2 kOhm, 'LS175 column: clear publishes tPHL (Q falls) and tPLH (/Q rises) as separate rows, so each output carries only its own edge. Data setup 20 ns, data hold 5 ns
TI SDLS090, October 1976, revised March 1988 (SN74LS273), switching characteristics, CL = 15 pF, RL = 2 kOhm: clear is published as tPHL only. Data setup 20 ns, data hold 5 ns

TI SDLS165B, October 1975, revised August 2002 (SN74LS374), switching characteristics, RL = 667 Ohm, CL = 45 pF (5 pF for the disable times), 'LS374 column. Data setup 20 ns; data hold 5 ns: the SN74LS374 column's 0 ns holds only below 10 MHz, and the sheet asks for 5 ns above

TI SDLS167, October 1976, revised March 1988 (SN74LS377), switching characteristics, CL = 15 pF, RL = 2 kOhm. Setup 20 ns for data; enable is the worse of enable active-state (25) and inactive-state (10); hold 5 ns for data and enable
